prompts.name: frame
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production-ready 2D mobile game HUD asset for Emberfall. VERY SIMPLE RESTRAINED LOW-DETAIL GAME UI, readable at 24 pixels. Dark navy, muted violet, cyan accents, same palette as dark fantasy HUD but greatly simplified. Flat colors, only 2 or 3 tones per material, crisp clean geometric silhouettes and uniform thin outlines. No realistic rendering, no stone grain, cracks, marbling, swirling energy, metallic reflections, particles, bloom, sparkles, elaborate bevels or excessive highlights. Actual transparent alpha outside the asset (never painted checkerboard). Single isolated complete object centered with small safety margin. No text or numbers except requested plus. One empty very wide horizontal HUD frame, 6:1. Single slim muted-purple border, clipped corners, solid uniform dark navy opaque interior. Only one tiny cyan diamond centered on the top edge and a tiny purple notch on each end. Border takes less than 6% of panel height. No skull, horns, spikes, wings, side crystals or inner compartments. Large flat empty interior.
